00049 FFTEngine::FFTEngine(const int fftSize) throw()

00052 }
00053 
00054 FFTEngine::FFTEngine(FFTEngine const& copy) throw()

00057     internal->incrementRefCount();

00059 
00060 FFTEngine& FFTEngine::operator= (FFTEngine const& other) throw()
00061 {
00062     if (this != &other)
00063     {       
00064         internal->decrementRefCount();
00065         internal = other.internal;
00066         internal->incrementRefCount();
00067     }
00068     
00069     return *this;
00070 }
